preconditions.description: The input string m has length n between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#_' for c in m)
preconditions.description: The string m consists only of characters '#' and '_'.

postconditions.description: Output is -1 if and only if no profile exists that produces the given mask m.
Output is a valid profile description if and only if at least one profile exists that produces the given mask m.
When a solution exists, the first line is an integer k (number of profile elements) and there are exactly two lines.

postconditions.expression: (stdout != '-1\n') and (int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) == len([int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()]))
postconditions.description: The integer k on the first line equals the count of integers on the second line.
Every integer in the output profile is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: (stdout != '-1\n') and (mask_from_profile([int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()], len(m)) == m)
postconditions.description: The output profile, when converted to a mask for length n, exactly matches the input string m.
